title: Courtroom Juror Ballot
description: Structured, neutral vote payload submitted by an isolated juror agent.

vote.description: Exact case-sensitive juror verdict: GUILTY, NOT_GUILTY, or ABSTAIN.

confidence.description: Integer confidence score from 0 to 100 inclusive.

critical_objections.description: Non-discardable list of critical blockers raised by the juror.

concessions.description: Aspects of the proposal acknowledged as valid or well-defended.

dissent.description: Juror's dissenting reasoning or explanatory note; empty string if none.
